root_cause.text: iommu_dma_iova_link_swiotlb() failed to handle the case where removing unaligned head and tail leaves a zero-length aligned middle segment, causing an illegal 0-size iommu_map/__dma_iova_link call and then unwinding from offset 0 instead of the current offset, which corrupts the IOVA mapping state.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a guard `if (size)` before calling `__dma_iova_link(...)` after `size -= iova_end_pad`, with the comment “there may be no aligned middle left to map,” and changes error cleanup from `dma_iova_unlink(..., 0, mapped, ...)` to `dma_iova_unlink(..., offset, mapped, ...)`; the commit message explicitly says the middle can be empty, `iommu_map()` with size 0 is illegal, and the unwind “starts from the wrong spot corrupting the mapping.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Skip zero-length middle IOVA linking after head/tail trimming so tail bounce mapping still works without invoking `__dma_iova_link()` on an empty range.
intent_record.what: The code now adds a comment explaining that after removing partial head and tail padding there may be no aligned middle segment left, subtracts `iova_end_pad` from `size` as before, but wraps the call to `__dma_iova_link(dev, addr + mapped, phys + mapped, size, dir, attrs)` and the subsequent `mapped += size` inside `if (size) { ... }` so they only execute when the remaining middle size is nonzero.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this prevents attempting to link a zero-length middle mapping when the aligned central portion disappears after trimming head and tail padding. The function will skip the unnecessary `__dma_iova_link()` call in that case while still allowing the tail bounce handling to proceed, avoiding incorrect or failing zero-size mapping behavior.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the out_unmap error path to only unlink existing mappings and use the correct offset for cleanup.
intent_record.what: The cleanup path at label out_unmap was changed from an unconditional call to dma_iova_unlink(dev, state, 0, mapped, dir, attrs) to a conditional call guarded by if (mapped), and the third argument was changed from the constant 0 to offset.
intent_record.how: At runtime, error handling now skips dma_iova_unlink() when no length was actually mapped, and when partial mapping exists it unlinks using the correct offset instead of always starting at 0. This prevents incorrect cleanup of the wrong IOVA range and avoids invoking unlink on an empty mapping.
